svg.text: Each cell: the cohort's mean share, and a dot whose colour is log2 of it over the other cohorts' mean (blue lower, red higher, clamped at ±2), size −log10 q, outlined
when q < 0.05. 30 comparisons tested, 0 at q < 0.05.
Each sample's 10 parts (entities of “Cell Type Relative Fractions”), divided by their sum so every bar is a whole; cases ordered by T_cell, highest first. Each cohort is
compared with the view's other cohorts pooled, part by part: log2 of the ratio of means (each + 0.001), Welch's t from the cohorts' n, mean and variance,
Benjamini–Hochberg across the 30 comparisons. Parts of a whole are not independent — one part's rise is the others' fall — and a case in two cohorts counts in both.
Entropy is Shannon's (natural log) over each case's shares.
